name: Extrêmes flamboyants
description: In the intense heat of battle, warriors extend and contract their bodies to the very limit in order to unleash maximal power. The explosive tension of such "dynamics" is also a key element that can be observed and analyzed in certain works of graffiti. Thus, if one personally joins in the fray, they will almost certainly be able to capture superlative critical "dynamic" moments themselves...|Map Marker Description
